offering_description.value: Licenses stock and editorial photos, illustrations, and video to media companies, marketers, businesses, and individual creators. It delivers content from staff photographers and independent contributors through online libraries and enterprise accounts. It also offers custom shoots, AI image generation, and a free photo platform with paid upgrades and advertising.

primary_products.value: Stock photographs; editorial photographs; stock and editorial video footage; illustrations and vectors

primary_services.value: Custom photo and video production; commissioned event photography; AI image generation; advertising placements on a free photo platform

customer_segment.value: B2B: Publishers, broadcasters, advertising agencies, brands, and corporate marketing teams; B2C: Independent creators, hobbyists, and individuals buying imagery for personal projects

end_markets.value: News and publishing; advertising and marketing; entertainment and sports media; corporate communications; digital content creation

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Rights to use individual images, illustrations, and video clips; subscription: Recurring access to premium visual libraries and download allowances; transaction or usage fees: Generation credits for creating AI images; project or contract: Commissioned shoots and event coverage; advertising: Sponsored imagery and ad placements on the free photo platform
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; subscription; transaction or usage fees; project or contract; advertising

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Aggregates contributor and staff imagery and licenses it to publishers, marketers, and creators; software / platform: Connects photographers and illustrators with people who search, download, or license visual content; service provider: Uses photographers and production crews to create commissioned visuals for brands and organizations

geography_served.value: global: Customers across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Stock and editorial libraries, custom production, AI image generation, and a free photo platform

distribution_channels.value: online: Self-service websites for searching, licensing, downloading, and generating imagery; direct sales: Enterprise account teams and custom production sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Copyright, privacy, and publicity rights govern image licensing, releases, and reuse

notes: The profile covers Getty Images on a standalone basis; I cannot confirm the current status of its proposed merger with Shutterstock.
